source_lineage: Existing real DanceTrack TRAIN candidate tapes and real-image first-eligible one-click anchors
split_rule: 8 outer sequence folds. For outer i, cyclic next sequence is inner; other 6 are parameter-fit. No frame-IID split. Hyperparameters, accept thresholds and checkpoints see only fit+inner; outer never selects them.
exposure: All eight development scenes have historical research exposure. They are not virgin independent validation. Strict frozen comparator checkpoints exclude current outer and inner from their own parameter fit, but repeated historical methodology exposure is disclosed.
future_frames: Every frame after the target's initialization until the actual sequence end, exactly once per target episode. Multiple target episodes from one scene are correlated.
candidate_labeling: Offline deterministic one-to-one >=0.5 matching. Unmatched is invalid/unresolved, not verified another physical person. Separate selected-box target IoU recall.
gap_semantics: Visible-GT absence; do not infer out-of-view versus complete occlusion without validated labels.
density_source: Current runtime candidate counts, never GT person density

new_training.device: CPU until a genuinely available GPU can be used safely
new_training.best_checkpoint: Inner loss then inner recall at the fit-selected safe threshold; never outer performance
